### Meaning
| infl.      | class        | meaning                      |
| ---------- | ------------ | ---------------------------- |
| ~          | *n.*         | eye / (sight)                |
| ~en        | *v.*         | to see, watch, observe (tr.) |
| ...thu ~en | *v. caus.*   | to show                      |
| ~a         | *psv.*       | seen                         |
| ...thu ~a  | *psv. caus.* | shown                        |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
oracle bone script of 目
#### Sound
- Japanese reading of 見 (mi-ru)
- *a priori:* m=humanness, i=focus
